question: How many delegates participated in the second session of Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**436.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian National Congress**

 
 
• The second session of the **Indian National Congress **featured **436 delegates**.
 
• The **Congress Party,** usually referred to as the **INC **or just the **Congress** is a reputable political organisation in **India**.
 
• In the British Empire's Asia and Africa, it was the first modern nationalist movement to emerge after its founding in 1885.
 
• Beginning in the late 19th century and particularly after 1920, **Congress** assumed command of the Indian independence movement under **Mahatma Gandhi's guidance.**
 
• Both the independence of India from the** United Kingdom** and the different anti-colonial nationalist movements within the **British Empire** was made possible by the **Congress**.
